court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Vijaya K. Tahilramani, C.J. and M. Duraiswamy, J.)
appellants: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited, rep. by its Authorised Signatory Deputy Manager (Legal) K. Siva Raja Pandian .…. Petitioner;
respondents: District Magistrate/District Collector and Others .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: S.N. Parthasarathi Government Advocate for respondent No. 1
judgment_text:
Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issue of Writ of Mandamus directing the first respondent to dispose of and pass orders on the application of the petitioner filed under Section 14 of the SARFAESI Act dated 06.05.2019 against the respondents 2 to 5 within a time frame to be fixed by this Hon'ble Court.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Vijaya K. Tahilramani, C.J.:— Mr. S.N. Parthasarathi, learned Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of the first respondent.

2. This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking a writ of mandamus directing the first respondent to pass orders on the petition dated 06.05.2019 filed by the petitioner under Section 14 of the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002 (in short, ‘SARFAESI Act’).

3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Government Advocate appearing for the first respondent.

4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that though the petition was filed by the petitioner on 06.05.2019, the first respondent-District Collector has not disposed of the same till date. He submitted that in view of the long pendency of the matter, the petitioner is not in a position to take possession of the property.

5. Having regard to the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and taking note of the limited prayer sought for in this writ petition, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we direct the first respondent to consider and pass orders on the petition dated 06.05.2019 filed by the petitioner under Section 14 of the SARFAESI Act on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, after giving notice to all concerned.

6. With the above observation, the writ petition is disposed of. No costs.
